subject: Req pause and short-term redeploy for product org — offers & comp bands
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Req pause and short-term redeploy for product org — offers & comp bands

Team,

Following the exec update, we need to temporarily pause new external offers for product org roles that are in bands 4–6 while Compensation finalizes the harmonized band floor/ceiling. Goal is to avoid offer churn and to ensure parity across regions.

Immediate ask:
- Pause issuing formal offers for 12 open product reqs listed in the attached spreadsheet (proposed-req-redistribution.xlsx).
- Allow recruiters to continue candidate outreach (hold warm) but defer signed offers until comp band memo is published.
- Reallocate 3 mid-priority reqs to the Center-of-Excellence (COE) pool for Q1 backfills; COE will own redistributing headcount to critical teams.
- Approve short-term contractor conversions (3 roles) where continuity risk is high; procurement will run 60-day vendor-to-FTE clauses.

Please review the attached and confirm by EOD which reqs you can pick up for redeployment. If you have candidates with signed Letters, notify me immediately so we can escalate to THR for exceptions.

Thanks,
Karthik
Karthik Iyer
VP, Product Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: proposed-req-redistribution.xlsx (spreadsheet, 32KB)

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 11:40:15 -0800
Subject: Re: Req pause and short-term redeploy for product org — offers & comp bands

Karthik,

Thanks for the heads up. I reviewed the sheet — I can absorb three of the mid-priority reqs (PR-112, PR-118, PR-123) into my team for now, but I need the updated compensation bands before making firm offer decisions. Two questions:

1) Will the harmonized band memo include market adjustments for SF vs remote? I need clarity for candidate expectations.
2) For the contractor conversions, do we have budget sign-off or is that subject to the same freeze?

I'll mark the reqs in the sheet and tag them 'LAURA-pickup'. Looping Marissa for candidate status.

-Laura
Laura Bennett
Hiring Manager, Product
Redwood Inference

From: Emma Lin <emma@talentbridge.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 13:05:22 -0800
Subject: Re: Req pause and short-term redeploy for product org — offers & comp bands

Hi Karthik,

Appreciate the transparency. Quick note from the field:
- I currently have two candidates (CJ Morales and Priya Kumar) who were prepping for final offers this week. Both are strong but would likely need an updated TTL (time-to-accept) if we delay.
- We can keep them engaged via a short executive touchpoint or virtual coffee — happy to coordinate.

If exceptions are allowed for signed letters, please tell us the criteria and turnaround for escalation.

Best,
Emma Lin
Senior Recruiter, TalentBridge

Attachment: candidate-briefs.pdf (8 pages)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Emma Lin <emma@talentbridge.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Req pause and short-term redeploy for product org — offers & comp bands

Emma — thanks.

On Tue, 17 Nov 2026 13:05:22 -0800 Emma Lin <emma@talentbridge.com> wrote:
> Hi Karthik,
> 
> Appreciate the transparency. Quick note from the field:
> - I currently have two candidates (CJ Morales and Priya Kumar) who were prepping for final offers this week. Both are strong but would likely need an updated TTL (time-to-accept) if we delay.
> - We can keep them engaged via a short executive touchpoint or virtual coffee — happy to coordinate.
> 
> If exceptions are allowed for signed letters, please tell us the criteria and turnaround for escalation.

Short answers and next steps:
- Signed signed-off Letters: escalate to THR (Talent & HR) AND include Finance approval. Criteria = candidate already at final-stage + offer letter countersigned by candidate and manager approval on comp. We will triage these within 48 hours.
- Market adjustments (SF vs remote): Compensation is adding a market overlay; memo expected COB Thursday. It will spell out locality adjustments and whether we apply prorated overlays vs band reassignments.
- Contractor conversions: we have an interim budget allowance for conversions that are business-critical (service continuity risk). Procurement and Finance must sign the SR work order; I will circulate a short checklist.

Action items:
- Marissa: please update the candidate tracker and flag any offers that are already signed.
- Laura: confirm the COE pickup in the sheet by EOD.
- Vivek: I will need headcount reallocation approval for Q1 to move three reqs into COE.

I attached a two-page summary of the expected headcount impact (req-impact-summary.pdf) and my availability for a quick sync (cal-availability.ics).

Thanks,
Karthik
VP, Product Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: req-impact-summary.pdf (2 pages), cal-availability.ics (calendar invite)
